entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: To think you'd make the same mistake[n]again. You're hopeless!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've memorized their faces real good.[n]You're goin' down!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: It seems it's true when they say "barking[n]dogs seldom bite."

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: How far the star runner of the track team[n]has fallen.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the hell are you gettin' at!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: I speak of the "Track Traitor" who acted in[n]violence, ending his teammates' dreams.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Oh, I can only imagine the pain of the[n]others who were dragged under with[n]your... selfish act.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: What a surprise. So you're accompanying[n]him without knowing anything at all?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: He betrayed his teammates and crushed[n]their hopes, yet he still carries on as[n]carefree as ever.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: What a tragedy... You blindly trusted[n]this fool, and he's led you right to[n]your death.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Hurry up and dispose of them. I can't[n]stand their stench.
